notes.title: From the mind of YOKO TARO: The Voice of Cards Trilogy is on sale now!
notes.notes:
The Voice of Cards series are quirky RPGs where the whole world is depicted through the medium of cards.

Voice of Cards Trilogy brings together all three games from the series; “The Isle Dragon Roars”, “The Forsaken Maiden” and “The Beasts of Burden” in one extra-value set.

In the Voice of Cards games you will experience the atmosphere of playing a tabletop RPG, listening to narration by the game master along the way, and with the outcomes of events and battles occasionally resting on the fall of the dice.
Each of the games in the trilogy is based in the same setting, but their respective stories are completely unconnected, so you are free to start from whichever one you please.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30738/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41258953/4f874a7503ea925a404d6d3bd229d4f66e2ebc37.png[/img][/url]

Bringing you a new, yet nostalgic gaming experience from YOKO Taro (Creative director) , Okabe Keiichi (Music director) and Fujisaka Kimihiko (Character designer).

A “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” is also available, containing DLC that lets you change the designs of in-game items such as card backs and playing pieces to a theme based on YOKO Taro's other works, as well as DLC to change the BGM and the illustrations to a pixel art style.

*The various content included in “Voice of Cards Trilogy” and “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” are identical to the same items sold separately. Please take care to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Please be aware that services requiring an internet connection may be closed down after a set time has passed from the game’s release.

notes.title: Не карточная игра: Обзор Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars от Ёко Таро
notes.notes: В перерывах между развитием своей странной мультивселенной японский геймдизайнер и сценарист Ёко Таро занимается целым множеством занимательных вещей. Например, дает смешные интервью, ставит театральные постановки и трудится над сторонними проектами, о существовании которых широкая аудитория может даже не подозревать. Именно к последним следует отнести Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars — новую ролевую игру издательства Square Enix, дебютировавшую минувшей осенью на PC, а также PlayStation 4 и Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: Added a feature that allows Game Speed to be changed to "High Speed"
notes.notes:
A feature has been added that allows Game Speed to be changed to "High Speed" in this patch.

If you go to Game Settings under Options, select Game Speed, and choose High Speed, the speed of the game will increase (excluding in some areas).
The game speed will return to Normal upon closing the software.
Furthermore, you can switch the speed by pressing and holding the R key on the keyboard whilst in the field.

Due to increased stress caused by "High Speed" gameplay, however, if you select High Speed, the game may start to act...strange. If that happens, please reset the speed to Normal. 

(This feature will not be added to "Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars Demo".)

Voices of Cards: The Island Dragon Roars review
notes.notes: Hot on the heels of Inscryption, Voice of Cards is another card game where all is not as it seems. But where Daniel Mullins' feverish cabin battler dealt you a hand of jokers and proved more than the sum of its parts, Square Enix has barely shuffled the deck. This is despite featuring creative input from Yoko Taro, he of Nier and papier-mâché head fame. Come to this expecting his galaxy (moon?) brained genre subversion and the biggest twist is how ploddingly basic it all is... Read more.

Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is out now!

This game is an RPG  presented entirely through the medium of cards, from the plains to the towns to the dungeons...
Battles take place in a turn-based system on a tabletop board, with the thrilling roll of a dice deciding damage and the status effects that are dealt!

Additional DLC to alter the design and motifs of the dice, cards and other objects used in the game is also available!

Check out this fascinating world of swords and sorcery, brough to you from the creative talents of YOKO TARO (Creative Director), Keiichi Okabe (Music Director) and Kimihiko Fujisaka (Character Designer)!

notes.title: Nier's Yoko Taro teases new card-based RPG
notes.notes:
UPDATE 24/9/21: Tonight brought our first look at Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars in action, courtesy of its reveal trailer which debuted in tonight's Nintendo Direct.

Even better, we heard it would be released soon - on 28th October - with a free demo available from the Nintendo eShop today. Oh, and it's also coming to PlayStation 4 and PC.

"Players will square off in experiences that reveal themselves through cards, including turn-based battles, where their skills - and a little bit of luck - will determine the victor," the game's blurb reads, describing Voice of Cards as a "fresh take on tabletop RPGs".
